CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization is stated.

COD.rationale: Content (color assignments), their spatial pattern coordinates (organization), and separate origin/status metadata are all explicitly stated for matching referent/time pairs.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change relation tied to the listed contents/organization is asserted.

C.rationale: Explicit content entries identify color-labeled content and their coordinate sets in current and conditional candidate records.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status metadata (completed_record, native_conditional_record, inherited_origin) are provided distinct from the color/coordinate content lines.

O.rationale: Coordinate sets explicitly describe how content is organized/presented in both current and conditional candidate records.
